Text.Text: I am Malen Dray, and I keep the tomb rosters for the Academy's overseers. Lately I cross out more acolytes' names than I add. You are no acolyte, so perhaps you can be useful.
The overseers do not give thanks, but they do pay, and I pay on their behalf. Here is your reward.
You have returned. Four acolytes entered the crypt yesterday and four came out. Did you destroy all eight Sith Apprentices?

Most of them die in the Sith Crypt. Apprentices who failed their trials are buried there, and their ghosts kill living acolytes out of spite. I need you to go into the Sith Crypt and destroy eight of these Sith Apprentices. Come back to me here in the cantina when it is done and I will pay you.
Good. Kill eight Sith Apprentices in the Sith Crypt on Korriban, then come back to me here.
Fighting them is meant to be the acolytes' trial. The trouble is that the ghosts are winning it, and the Academy is running short of acolytes.
You still need to kill eight Sith Apprentices in the Sith Crypt on Korriban. Come back to me when it is done.
Here is your pay, in full. I will tell the overseers that the crypt cleared itself, because they prefer that.
You have returned, and the acolytes tell me the crypt is warmer. Did you destroy all four Sith Frostbinders?

No, they are not. Sith Frostbinders walk among them. In life they turned the cold of the tomb into a weapon, and death has not stopped them. An acolyte they touch does not get up again. I need you to destroy four Sith Frostbinders in the Sith Crypt. Come back to me here when it is done.
Good. Kill four Sith Frostbinders in the Sith Crypt on Korriban, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill four Sith Frostbinders in the Sith Crypt on Korriban. Come back to me when it is done.
That is six fewer reasons for me to cross a name off the temple roster. Here is your pay.
You have returned. I hear a hide trader is complaining that his market is flooded. Did you kill all six Tuk'ata?

Tuk'ata guard them. The old Sith Lords bred those hounds to protect their tombs, and they still do. They can smell the Force on an acolyte, and they hate it. I need you to kill six Tuk'ata in the Valley Temple Interiors. Come back to me here in the cantina when it is done and I will pay you.
Good. Kill six Tuk'ata in the Valley Temple Interiors on Korriban, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill six Tuk'ata in the Valley Temple Interiors on Korriban. Come back to me when it is done.
The Academy does not forgive deserters, and now it does not have to. My page is tidy again. Here is your pay.
You have returned. I have six names waiting for a line through them. Did you kill all six Rogue Initiates?

Some of them try. The deserters hide in the Valley Temple Interiors and steal from the acolytes who are still training. My roster lists them as missing, and the Academy wants them listed as dead. I need you to kill six Rogue Initiates in the Valley Temple Interiors. Come back to me here when it is done.
Good. Kill six Rogue Initiates in the Valley Temple Interiors on Korriban, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill six Rogue Initiates in the Valley Temple Interiors on Korriban. Come back to me when it is done.
The Council pays well when its own hand stays hidden. Here is your pay. Ask me who stands behind his guards when you want more work.
You have returned. I hear the Temple Master has doubled his watch, so he is afraid. Did you kill all twelve Sith Temple Guards?

There is one. A Temple Master decided the Academy answered to him, and he seized the Sith Fortress with enough guards to hold it. The Dark Council wants him removed without being seen to do it. Start with his guards. I need you to kill twelve Sith Temple Guards in the Sith Fortress, then come back to me here.
Good. Kill twelve Sith Temple Guards in the Sith Fortress on Korriban, then come back to me here.
If a Sith kills him, that Sith takes the Fortress, and we face the same trouble again in a year. An outsider like you can simply be paid.
There are guards on the Approach and in the Courtyard, Forgeworks below, and his own quarters at the top. Everything inside is stronger than anything you have met in the wastes.
You still need to kill twelve Sith Temple Guards in the Sith Fortress on Korriban. Come back to me when it is done.
Here is your pay. Only one door now stands between you and him, and it has a keeper. Ask me about it.
You have returned. The Temple Master is running out of people who believe in him. Did you kill six of his Marauders or Sorceresses?

His own students stand behind them. They are Sith Marauders and Sorceresses who chose him over the Academy, and I want them to learn that it was a poor choice. I need you to kill six Sith Marauders or Sorceresses in the Sith Fortress. Either kind counts. Come back to me here when it is done.
Good. Kill six Sith Marauders or Sorceresses in the Sith Fortress on Korriban, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill six Sith Marauders or Sorceresses in the Sith Fortress on Korriban. Come back to me when it is done.
His students come next, the Marauders and Sorceresses. First finish killing the twelve Sith Temple Guards I asked you for.
Here is your pay. Nothing stands between you and the Temple Master now. Tell me when you are ready to face him.
You have returned, and I am told the gate stands open. I did not expect to write that down. Is the Temple Guardian dead?

The Temple Guardian keeps it. It stood at that gate before the Temple Master was born, and it does not care who gives the orders, only that the gate holds. It also carries the gate key. I need you to kill the Temple Guardian in the Sith Fortress and take the key, then come back to me here.
Good. Kill the Temple Guardian in the Sith Fortress on Korriban, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill the Temple Guardian in the Sith Fortress on Korriban. Come back to me when it is done.
The gate comes next, along with the guardian that holds it. First finish killing his six Marauders or Sorceresses.
Then I can cross out the last name. Here is the Council's payment, in full. They asked me to say they were never involved.
You have returned. The Fortress banners came down at dawn, and every acolyte on Korriban saw it. Is the Sith Temple Master dead?

It is time. The gate is open, and he is waiting in the Lord's Quarters at the top of the Sith Fortress. He expects the Council to send a Sith against him, so you will be a surprise. I need you to go to the Lord's Quarters and kill the Sith Temple Master. Come back to me here when he is dead.
Good. Kill the Sith Temple Master in the Lord's Quarters of the Sith Fortress on Korriban, then come back to me here.
Bring everyone you trust, and then bring more. He trained half the Marauders on this world, and he fights better than any of them.
You still need to kill the Sith Temple Master in the Lord's Quarters of the Sith Fortress on Korriban. Come back to me when it is done.
The Temple Master himself comes after the gate. First kill the Temple Guardian in the Sith Fortress so that the gate is open.
I will leave you to your rosters.
What else is killing your acolytes?
Yes, all eight apprentices are laid to rest.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will destroy eight Sith Apprentices.
No, the dead can keep their crypt.
Why not let the acolytes fight the ghosts themselves?
What is killing the acolytes on your roster?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Sith Apprentices.
Yes, all four Frostbinders are gone.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will destroy four Sith Frostbinders.
No, I have no wish to freeze to death.
Are the apprentices the worst thing in the crypt?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Sith Frostbinders.
Yes, all six Tuk'ata are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. I will kill six Tuk'ata.
No, the hounds can keep their tombs.
What guards the temples in the valley?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Tuk'ata.
Yes, all six deserters are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill six Rogue Initiates.
No, leaving was their own choice to make.
Do acolytes ever desert the Academy?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Rogue Initiates.
Yes, all twelve guards are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill twelve Sith Temple Guards.
No, that is a war between Sith.
Why doesn't the Council send Sith to kill him?
What will I find inside the Fortress?
Is there a name on your roster you cannot cross out?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Sith Temple Guards.
Yes, six of his students are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill six of his students.
No, I have seen enough of the Fortress.
Who stands behind the Temple Master's guards?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Sith Marauders or Sorceresses.
What comes after the Temple Master's guards?
Yes, the Temple Guardian is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill the Temple Guardian.
No, I will stop here for now.
Who keeps the last door in the Fortress?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Temple Guardian.
What comes after the Temple Master's students?
Yes, the Sith Temple Master is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill the Sith Temple Master.
No, I am not ready to face him yet.
Do you have any advice for fighting him?
Is it time to deal with the Temple Master himself?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Sith Temple Master.
What comes after the gate?
